## UPLOAD_TTL_MS variable

How long an upload accepts bytes and can be consumed: 15 minutes from its creation.

**Signature:**

```typescript
UPLOAD_TTL_MS: number
```

## Remarks

Long enough to send [MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES](./runtime.max_upload_bytes.md) over a slow link and then make the call that uses it; short enough that abandoned uploads free their slot and their disk space soon.
